name: fs_putfilep

ownership.argument: Astrolink binds this as F_FS_PUTFILEP(file) to drop the file-list reference it took with fs_getfilep, right after file_dup3 has copied the pipe write end.

provenance.source: Single-argument release: asserts the file is non-NULL against fs_files.c:906, takes the scheduler critical section through BASEPRI, decrements the reference count at file+4, and when it reaches zero calls the list release at 0xC1CEC54 and logs '%s: ERROR: fs putfilep file_close() failed' on failure. Its callers in the VFS layer are the fs_* wrappers, which obtain the file with fs_getfilep immediately before and release it immediately after (e.g. 0xC1CFD48 for fchstat, 0xC1D1258 and 0xC1D25F4 around the readv/writev pair).

notes: Astrolink binds this as F_FS_PUTFILEP(file) to drop the file-list reference it took with fs_getfilep, right after file_dup3 has copied the pipe write end.
